definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 学校食堂 (school cafeteria). Refers to the on-campus dining facility at a university or college. A casual, everyday term used mainly by students.

examples.japanese: {学食|がくしょく}で{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate lunch at the school cafeteria.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}の{学食|がくしょく}は{安|やす}くておいしい。
examples.english: This university's cafeteria is cheap and delicious.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}みの{学食|がくしょく}は{学生|がくせい}でいっぱいになる。
examples.english: The cafeteria gets packed with students during lunch break.

notes:
USAGE:
An abbreviation of {学校|がっこう}{食堂|しょくどう}. Used almost exclusively in reference to university or college dining halls, not elementary or middle school cafeterias. Very common in student conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学食|がくしょく}で{食|た}べる: to eat at the cafeteria
- {学食|がくしょく}のメニュー: cafeteria menu
- {学食|がくしょく}が{混|こ}む: the cafeteria is crowded

WORD FORMATION:
Abbreviation pattern: {学|がく} (school) + {食|しょく} (food/dining). This type of two-kanji abbreviation is common in Japanese campus slang.
